_help: Empty values hide that feature: no ad markup, no ads.txt, no newsletter form, and no affiliate tag on product links. A publisher id puts the AdSense script in the head of every page and writes public/ads.txt. Leave slot ids empty so no manual ad unit is reserved and the layout does not change. Auto ads are switched on in the AdSense account, not here. Cloudflare Web Analytics loads on every page for every visitor and is not gated by the cookie banner. The banner does not load or block the AdSense script. In the EEA, advertising consent is Google's Privacy & messaging European regulations message, enabled in the AdSense account. Amazon tags: en is the amazon.com associate tag, nl is the amazon.nl associate tag. Newsletter action is the full https URL of the form endpoint; email_field is the input name the provider expects.
